hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"stop_hook_active":true'*) exit 0;; esac; changed="$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 -- 2>/dev/null; git diff --name-only; git diff --cached --name-only)"; if echo "$changed" | grep -qxE '(vercel\.json|schema\.sql|package\.json|lib/auth\.js)' && ! echo "$changed" | grep -qx 'CLAUDE.md'; then echo 'High-signal file changed (vercel.json / schema.sql / package.json / lib/auth.js) without a CLAUDE.md update. Check the trigger table at the top of CLAUDE.md and update the matching section in the same commit — or state explicitly why no update is needed.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
